recipe.initialization: Clone selected corrected-data SEA-LION seed425 epoch2 LoRA into new rewriting adapter; never overwrite/change original English/direct adapter. Same pinned BF16 base.

training.selection: Minimum42 reference-anchored LOCAL validation tokenCE among trained epochs1+. No selection on sampled outputs; CE under different conditioning/subset is not comparable with previous direct50 CE.
training.loss: FP32 reply-only causal CE; conversation and English anchor fully masked, real EOS retained, no truncation.

evaluation.baseline: Frozen seed425 direct English/LOCAL results from356064 on identical12+20+50 inputs; English generator never fine-tuned here.
evaluation.diagnostic: 32 explicitly assistant-authored context-compatible English anchors; reused development, not independent human gold, never training targets. Actual English may contradict context; separate anchor fidelity from contextual correctness. No exact reference-intent requirement or particle-count reward.
criteria: Does rewritten LOCAL preserve English actors, polarity, amounts, times and decision?
Does it remain context-compatible where anchor is compatible?
Is it natural Singlish according to user judgement?
Does English-first pipeline improve over direct LOCAL on same frozen English outputs?
evaluation.limitations: Teacher English anchors at training differ from generated English at inference; route mismatch explicitly measured. Conservative assistant exclusions can be imperfect. Pilot one seed; no reliable quality claim or automatic app promotion.
